spec.description: Product and operations view of webhook receipt, processing, dependencies, and observability gaps.
Webhook requests acknowledged in the selected range. This is receipt, not proof of terminal business completion.
spec.title: Acknowledged

spec.description: Rejected or failed receipts divided by all webhook requests. Review at 1%; investigate immediately at 5%.
spec.title: Ingress exception rate

spec.description: Recorded terminal processing failures after acknowledgement. Any value requires investigation.
spec.title: Processing failures

spec.description: Retry events in the selected range. Deliberately uncoloured: a retry has not ended yet, so it is neither a success nor a failure. Retries becoming failures is what Processing failures reports. Confirm each retry later succeeded.
spec.title: Processing retries

spec.description: Action: inspect source validation/signature failures and correlated traces; confirm business impact before replaying anything.
spec.title: Action queue — ingress

spec.description: Action: inspect the named operation; confirm retry recovery or terminal state before manually intervening.
spec.title: Action queue — processing

spec.expr: (label_replace(vector(1), "source", "slack", "", "") or label_replace(vector(1), "source", "closing_desk", "", "") or label_replace(vector(1), "source", "gmail", "", "") or label_replace(vector(1), "source", "claude", "", "") or label_replace(vector(1), "source", "openphone", "", "") or label_replace(vector(1), "source", "llamaparse", "", "") or label_replace(vector(1), "source", "tivly", "", "") or label_replace(vector(1), "source", "aircall", "", "") or label_replace(vector(1), "source", "isc_extension", "", "") or label_replace(vector(1), "source", "bold_penguin", "", "") or label_replace(vector(1), "source", "benepath", "", "") or label_replace(vector(1), "source", "railway", "", "")) unless on (source) (sum by (source) (increase(soma_webhook_requests_total[$__range])) > 0)

spec.description: Action: verify whether traffic was expected during this range, then check sender configuration and endpoint health. Absence is unknown, not failure.
spec.title: Action queue — no observed traffic

spec.expr: 100 * ((sum by (source) (increase(soma_webhook_requests_total{source=~"$source", outcome=~"rejected|failed"}[$__range]))) or (sum by (source) (increase(soma_webhook_requests_total{source=~"$source"}[$__range])) * 0)) / clamp_min(sum by (source) (increase(soma_webhook_requests_total{source=~"$source"}[$__range])), 1)

spec.description: Stage counts for sources with telemetry. Processing events may fan out, so acknowledgement and success counts are not expected to match one-for-one.

spec.description: Rate of successfully acknowledged inbound webhook requests.
spec.title: Webhook acknowledgements by source

spec.description: Recorded post-receipt processing events. Retry and failed series should trigger investigation.
spec.title: Processing outcomes by source

spec.description: P95 time to return the webhook acknowledgement. This is not end-to-end business completion latency.

spec.description: P95 duration of instrumented post-receipt processing operations.
spec.title: Processing p95

spec.description: Bytes per second returned in webhook acknowledgements. Request-body/data-in bytes are not instrumented yet.
spec.title: Acknowledgement data out

spec.expr: label_join((100 * ((sum by (client, server) (rate(traces_service_graph_request_failed_total{client=~"soma-.*"}[$__rate_interval]))) or (sum by (client, server) (rate(traces_service_graph_request_total{client=~"soma-.*"}[$__rate_interval])) * 0)) / clamp_min(sum by (client, server) (rate(traces_service_graph_request_total{client=~"soma-.*"}[$__rate_interval])), 0.0001)) and on (client, server) (sum by (client, server) (rate(traces_service_graph_request_total{client=~"soma-.*"}[$__rate_interval])) > 0), "path", " → ", "client", "server")

label_join((1000 * sum by (client, server) (rate(traces_service_graph_request_client_seconds_sum{client=~"soma-.*"}[$__rate_interval])) / clamp_min(sum by (client, server) (rate(traces_service_graph_request_client_seconds_count{client=~"soma-.*"}[$__rate_interval])), 0.0001)) and on (client, server) (sum by (client, server) (rate(traces_service_graph_request_total{client=~"soma-.*"}[$__rate_interval])) > 0), "path", " → ", "client", "server")

spec.description: Raw OTel span-error percentage. This is not a business SLI: expected Angie transcript-not-ready 404 polling is currently counted as failure. Use traces before escalating.
spec.title: Raw dependency span errors — diagnostic only

spec.description: Observed production service-to-dependency paths. Queue handoffs are not connected across workers yet, so missing internal edges are a known tracing gap.
spec.title: Production service graph

options.content:
### Operator interpretation

- **Acknowledged** means SOMA received and answered a webhook. It does not prove the final business action completed.
- **Processing success/retry/failure** covers only instrumented operations after receipt. Counts may fan out and are not one-to-one with requests.
- A source missing from **Workflow health** is **Unknown / no observed telemetry**, never automatically healthy.
- Expected sources currently selectable: Slack, Closing Desk, Gmail, Claude, OpenPhone, LlamaParse, Tivly, Aircall, ISC Extension, Bold Penguin, Benepath, and Railway.
- The dependency table is a raw span-error diagnostic. Angie transcript polling returns an expected 404 while a transcript is not ready, so that table must not be used as a business-failure alert yet.

### Known safe coverage gaps

Request-body **data in**, queue depth/oldest-job age, exact cross-queue trace continuity, and terminal business outcomes are not measured yet. This dashboard performs no table mutations and uses telemetry only. Use **Soma Metrics** for engineering HTTP/collector diagnostics.
